# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer and housekeeper at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a tall, slender, and angular frame with sharp contours. Her hair is dark with graying and silvered strands, bound tightly at the back in a firm bun fastened by wire hairpins. She exhibits a sharp face with a mouth that suggests a hidden sense of humor when carefully nurtured.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c38 P11](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0011)_

## Personality

Thirza is a rigid, reserved, and austere woman with an unyielding sense of morality and a deep dislike for displayed emotion or lighthearted frivolity. Unaccustomed to easy outward affection or transparent speech, she often hides her true feelings behind sharp remarks, strictness, and fault-finding. Despite her stern exterior and insistence on order and clean decorum, she possesses a deeply compassionate, generous heart and a capacity for immense, profound love.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## Traits

- Rigid and stern  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)</sub>
- Obsessively neat and clean  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Suspicious of sunlight and frivolity  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Reserved and unemotional in speech  <sub>[v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)</sub>
- Fear of being overly lenient or idolizing mortal beings  <sub>[v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Knitting and dairy work  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v3 c22 P0](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0000)</sub>
- Housekeeping and farm management  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Nell Harcourt properly and give her a good home and education  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089)</sub>
- To maintain Grey Shutters and preserve the family home  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy spent her quiet, restricted youth and middle age residing with her brother Obed at their secluded farmstead, Grey Shutters. Intending to adopt a young orphan boy to assist on the farm, she and Obed mistakenly received Nell Harcourt, a young girl, from the asylum. Though initially stunned by the mistake, Thirza allowed Nell to stay on trial and quickly grew deeply attached to her, taking on the responsibility of her upbringing, education, and spiritual guidance. Following the death of her brother Obed, Thirza considered selling Grey Shutters due to grief and failing eyes, but chose to stay when Nell gave up a university scholarship to remain with her. As her vision improved and her sharp nature softened, she welcomed Mrs. Agatha Sowerby into her home to live together and took in the orphaned twins, Robin and Lucy Farrow.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley in the home built by her bashful, quiet father on the cleared edge of the property  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Overheard an aunt call her a 'dark, homely little thing' as a child, which caused her pain for decades  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited an oval amethyst brooch containing her mother's hair  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> No boy! However, a boy had to be there. Word was sent by us for Mrs. Tranter to bring a boy along.  <sub>[v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004)</sub>

> No; you can just address me as Thirza. Being called Miss Abernethy is something I am unaccustomed to, and it would cause me to feel nervous.  <sub>[v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>

> No. I am not an aunt to you, and I disbelieve in using names for people that do not belong to them.  <sub>[v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)</sub>

> I fail to see how that offers much advantage when you are constantly creating additional ones.  <sub>[v1 c21 P57](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0057)</sub>

> It came to his attention that Grey Shutters was to be sold by me, and he desires to purchase it.  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012)</sub>
